description: Transformation from agrarian to industrial society (18th–19th centuries)

overview.origin: Britain, then spread to Europe, North America, Japan

key_inventions.steam_engine: James Watt (1769 patent); efficient steam engine powered factories and transport
key_inventions.spinning_jenny: James Hargreaves (1764); spun multiple threads simultaneously
key_inventions.cotton_gin: Eli Whitney (1793); separated cotton fiber from seeds
key_inventions.bessemer_process: Henry Bessemer (1856); mass production of steel from iron

social_changes.urbanization: Population shifted from rural areas to industrial cities
social_changes.factory_system: Replaced cottage industry; standardized labor under one roof
social_changes.child_labor: Children worked long hours in dangerous conditions; led to reform laws
social_changes.working_class: New proletariat class emerged; poor wages, long hours, unsafe conditions
social_changes.middle_class_growth: Industrialists, merchants, professionals gained wealth and influence
social_changes.womens_roles: Working-class women entered factories; middle-class women expected to stay home

labor_movement.trade_unions: Workers organized for better wages and conditions
labor_movement.chartism: British working-class movement (1838–1857) demanding political reform
labor_movement.luddites: Workers who smashed machinery they saw as threatening their livelihoods

economic_theories.capitalism: Adam Smith's 'Wealth of Nations' (1776); free market, division of labor
economic_theories.marxism: Karl Marx's critique; workers vs. capitalists; Communist Manifesto (1848)

transportation_revolution.canals: Inland waterways for bulk goods transport
transportation_revolution.railways: Transformed travel time and goods movement; shrunk world
transportation_revolution.steamships: Replaced sailing ships; faster, more reliable ocean trade

key_figures.edison: Phonograph, light bulb, electrical power distribution
key_figures.ford: Assembly line for Model T automobile (1913)

environmental_impact.pollution: Coal burning caused severe air and water pollution
environmental_impact.deforestation: Cleared land for agriculture and cities
environmental_impact.urbanization: Overcrowded, unsanitary slums in industrial cities
environmental_impact.long_term: Foundation of the carbon emissions driving modern climate change
